contents.text: 恭喜你成功完成市集挖寶(3)！
為野生動物而走聯盟是一群關注野生動物保育與伴侶動物福祉的青年，期待能為無法言語野生動物與遊蕩犬貓發聲、讓更多人看見他們的困境。

The Alliance for Wildlife is a group of young people concerned with wildlife conservation and companion animal welfare. We hope to speak up for wild animals and stray dogs and cats who cannot speak for themselves, and to help more people recognize the challenges and hardships they face.
